messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout complete for inference-service:v7.2. Quick-prefill=on for us-west-2. Rolling to 100% staged by policy. dashboard: https://telemetry/internal/rollouts/3250012345 :rocket:
harper: starting post-deploy synthetic sweep (us-west-2). running 200 short-prefix probes now.
jin: first 50 -> prefix-miss spike, p99 tokens jumped to ~1.6s (baseline ~220ms). failures: 0.4% 5xx on synth path. attaching tiny snippet.
harper: paste (trim):
```
2026-05-12T09:12:10Z synth-prefill us-west-2 id=prf-21 status=200 latency=1620ms prefix_cache=miss host=usw2-04
2026-05-12T09:12:10Z backend: slow kv warmup for prefix batch size=128
```
rachel: interesting — cache-miss warmup windows can spike p99 while new shards receive traffic. any OOMs?
jin: no OOMs, memory steady. infra-bot says warmstart backfills saturated for a short window on hosts usw2-04 && usw2-11. ticket INF-5288 opened.
infra-bot: INF-5288: observed high kv-backfill RPS causing increased tail latency on hosts usw2-04, usw2-11 between 09:11-09:15. ops suggested pacing backfills.
harper: proposed immediate actions: 1) hold further ramp for 20m, 2) enable backfill-rate-limit to 50% on canary, 3) run 500 quick-probes, 4) if p99 remains >1s or errors >1%, pin routing for high-traffic customer routes (route: /v1/generate?customer=heavy-retail) to v7-stable (previous variant) for us-west-2 only.
rachel: +1. we should avoid full rollback since functional correctness is fine, it's perf-only. product-bot: note for release notes: "Transient prefill warmup caused higher tail latency in us-west-2; paced backfills and routing fallback ready."
jin: applying backfill throttle: `runtimectl set inference.backfill.rate_limit=0.5 --scope=canary-usw2`
infra-bot: rate-limit applied. autoscaler will smooth rebalancing.
harper: running 500 probes now. ETA ~3m.
(3m later)
harper: 500 probes -> 3 failures (0.6%), p95 240ms, p99 880ms. big improvement after throttle. host-level hotspot reduced.
rachel: good. decision: keep hold for 10 more minutes. if next 10m shows stable p99 < 900ms and errors <0.5%, resume ramp. if not, perform routing pin for heavy-retail route to v7-stable and notify customers.
jin: adding release-note snippet and INF-5288 link. command used to pin routing (manual if needed): `routerctl pin --region us-west-2 --route "customer=heavy-retail" --variant v7-stable --reason "postdeploy-prefill-tail"`
deploy-bot: Canary policy: auto-hold engaged due to elevated p99. Resume scheduled in 10m if metrics clear. telemetry snapshot: https://telemetry/internal/archives/3250012345
harper: TL;DR: hold + throttle prefill backfills in us-west-2; p99 improved; routing fallback prepared for a small heavy-traffic route if needed. will follow up with infra postmortem if recurrence.
product-bot: added note to changelog and staged customer comms template.
rachel: ack. thanks team :thumbsup:
